If you have tried to run this game on Linux, you will find that Bethesda's launcher application(the only proper way to install FO:S) is incompatible, and has earned a garbage rating for WINE.

However, the game itself works fine, although no launcher=no store(boohoo).

Here is what I did, and it works great: Get the game executable from here, and run it in WINE. DONE. It runs perfectly, the literal only issue is that since you are running the game without the Bethesda.net launcher, you have no access to the store for lunch boxes and shit - but there's a (somewhat time consuming) method to get around that.

The Android version stores saves in sdcard/Android/data/com.b ethsoft.falloutsh/files. You need to copy the Vault1.sav and Vault1.sav.bkp to your PC.

On Linux, or specifically WINE(or Windows, if you're a sadist), copy these two files to:

/home/yourusername/.wine/drive_c/users/yourusername/My Documents/My Games/Fallout Shelter.

This copies your Android save, along with any purchases you made - you will have all your unopened lunch boxes, all your Mr Handy bots, absolutely everything except direct access to the store.

EDIT: the link does download a pirate copy of the game, but the game is free so I don't think there is anything wrong with that.
